# Execution

[English](Execution.md) | [日本語](../../ja/data/Execution.md) | [Français](../../fr/data/Execution.md) | [中文](../../data/Execution.md)

<!-- Generated by npm run docs:localize; edit docs/i18n/translations.json. -->

Execution lifecycle and short-term retention are independent; terminal history cannot return to RUNNING.

{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "allOf": [
    {
      "if": {
        "properties": {
          "state": {

              "FAILED",
              "CANCELLED",
